description: Fetch a Dailymotion playlist by URL (dailymotion.com/playlist/{id}) or plain ID: name, description, owner, video count, and its videos in playlist order. Uses the public API, which matches the playlist page's content. Playlist IDs come from playlist page URLs, dailymotion/search --type playlist, or get-user --tab playlists. No login or browser required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Playlist URL (https://www.dailymotion.com/playlist/xa5jms) or just the ID (xa5jms). The last path segment is used as the playlist ID. Sources: playlist page URL, dailymotion/search --type playlist, or get-user --tab playlists. A nonexistent ID returns NOT_FOUND.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum videos to return (1-100, default 20). Paginates internally by fetching 100 videos per page; partial=true when the playlist has fewer videos than requested or the API's 1000-video pagination cap is hit.
